_readme: STRATEGY COHERENCE RULES — DAVID OWNS THIS FILE (same doctrine as signal_lenses.json). Each rule tests a STATED intent (a strategy dial the member actually set — provenance 'set'/'live' only, via _strategy_field) against the org's OWN answers. Hot-reloaded, no redeploy. Statuses: contradicted (practice runs against the stated intent) | behind_intent (short of it, direction known) | not_evidenced (the enabling evidence is unanswered). Statements are DESCRIPTIVE — both sides quoted, no directive verbs (DIRECTIVE_RE-clean by construction). An Approach metric may EVIDENCE a contradiction; it is never reported as a gap in its own right (brief v2 §2.2). Evidence here is the org's own response — no peer figure, so no n/suppression exposure. Rules are additive and independent; each is filed in exactly one category. intent.field 'document.segments' reads the strategy document, not a dial. STATUS: candidate set drafted 2026-08-14 from the Phase-0 evidence map (P4 Design label dropped — no live Design-class metric; N1 composed; G3/G4/G5 deferred to engine-native reads; P5 retired 2026-08-15 with the scarce-role segments it tested) — R7 sign-off pending David; refine or reject freely. EXTENSION 2026-08-16 (practitioner panel): the evidence grammar gains ONE intent-vs-intent shape — {"strategy_stance": <domain>, "in": [...]} reads the effective stance for a domain (domain_targets override, else the global dial) instead of a metric answer, because a strategy can pull against itself and no answer can evidence that. P6 (attract-led objective vs a below-market pay aim) is the first such rule, DRAFTED by Claude from the Head-of-Reward finding and pending David's R7 sign-off like the rest.

rules.statement: The stated mix leads on cash, and the main pay review runs with no regular cycle ({answer}, your response) — pay does the work of the package without a structured mechanism behind it.
rules.rationale: A cash-led package with no pay-review cadence has no lever to deliver the mix it claims.

rules.statement: Pay is stated as the same wherever people work, and geographic pay differentiation is in use ({answer}, your response).
rules.rationale: A location-agnostic stance and an in-use geographic pay structure cannot both hold.

rules.statement: Pay is stated as strongly performance-driven, and your responses show {answer_detail} — the stated differentiation has no mechanism carrying it.
rules.rationale: Strong P4P needs either a bonus population or performance-differentiated increases; with neither, the claim has no delivery path.

rules.statement: Pay is stated as held close across the board, and pay increases are strongly differentiated by performance rating ({answer}, your response).
rules.rationale: An egalitarian stance and strongly differentiated increases pull in opposite directions.

rules.statement: The package is stated to lead on financial wellbeing, and neither a financial-wellbeing programme nor default salary-sacrifice pension shows in your responses.
rules.rationale: A financial lead should be visible in at least one financial-wellbeing provision.

rules.statement: The package is stated to lead on mental wellbeing, and no Employee Assistance Programme shows in your responses.
rules.rationale: An EAP is the baseline mental-wellbeing provision; leading without one is hard to sustain.

rules.statement: Pay is described as fully open, and pay is never included in job adverts ({answer}, your response).
rules.rationale: Full openness that stops at the job advert is not the stance as stated.

rules.statement: Pay information is stated as shared internally, and pay bands are not visible to employees ({answer}, your response).
rules.rationale: Sharing ranges is the minimum the stated transparency position implies.

rules.statement: The stated objective is attracting the people you need, and pay — the part of the package a candidate weighs first — is aimed {answer}. The two intents pull in opposite directions, and the employer brand is left doing the work pay is declining to do.
rules.rationale: An attract-led strategy priced below market at its most visible component depends on everything except pay to win the candidate, which the rest of this document has to evidence.
